description: Income goal settings for the yield tracker (Objective 2 in docs/OBJECTIVES.md). Confirmed by Neel 2026-07-05. Margin limits are not exposed by Robinhood's API — update here when the lines change (Robinhood app > Margin Investing). Remaining/available margin IS pulled live via MCP (portfolio buying_power) for utilization display.

holdings_goal.base: market value of stock positions, all accounts

cash_goal.base: dynamic put capacity via /income/put-capacity: margin lines + cash balance in margin accounts, plus cash incl. put collateral in all other accounts (IRAs/Roths/401k). Refined by Neel 2026-07-05.

lot_disposal_method._note: Robinhood's per-account default tax-lot disposal method, as set in the app (Account -> Menu -> Investing -> Tax lots disposal method). It governs sells AND shares delivered by option assignment. Neel switched both taxable brokerages from FIFO to Highest Cost on 2026-09-13 (a Sunday; first trading day it applies to is 2026-09-14). scripts/rebuild_stock_lots.py reads this so the lot engine consumes lots the same way the broker does from the effective date -- before it, FIFO, which is what the 1099-Bs to date reflect. Playbook: call-assignment-tax-lot-notice. Accounts not listed are FIFO.
